sloka: ततस्समुद्रो धर्मात्मा समुत्थाय महाबलः ।अब्रवीद्वचनं राजन्नसुरं कालचोदितम् ॥४-११-१०॥।।
transliteration: tatassamudro dharmātmā samutthāya mahābalaḥ ।abravīdvacanaṁ rājannasuraṁ kālacoditam ॥4-11-10॥।।

translations.english: 'O king, then the powerful and righteous king of the ocean came out and spoke to the demon (Dundubhi) who was driven to death by fate.'
